# Schema builder (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`schema-builder`](../../flows/schema-builder/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The owner builds a content type definition as a field tree and exports it as JSON (flow schema-builder). The page (`/schema-builder`, owner only) starts or imports a definition, edits the type keys, shows the cms-api check live and exports the JSON. The canvas lists the fields (component boxes hold their own lists); every add, move, duplicate and delete has a plain control, choosing a field opens its properties in a popup, and rows with validator errors carry a marker.

## Techniques

One pure reducer owns the tree: ids are client-only, depth (3 levels) and the per-type key set (SB-8) are kept here; `default` is dropped on a type change except between `text` and `string` (SB-9); every other rule is left to the cms-api validator (D24). `titleField` and `subtitleField` (CM-14) are held only by a component: a retype drops them, turning `repeatable` off drops both, setting `titleField` to none drops `subtitleField`, and renaming a direct child renames its parent's reference; deleting, moving or retyping the child keeps the reference for the live check to report. Refused actions return the same state object. An import above `MAX_IMPORT_FIELDS` fields (all levels) is refused with `tooManyFields`, so a huge file cannot freeze the tab.

## Technologies

lucide-react (palette icons); the check runs through `useDefinitionValidation` of the content-types feature; copy in the `schemaBuilder` screen.

## Entry points

`SchemaBuilderPage` (route `SCHEMA_BUILDER`), `SchemaCanvas`, `SchemaDragContext`, `FieldPropertiesDialog`, `FieldPalette`, `useSchemaBuilderNavItems`, `schemaTreeReducer`, `addField`, `moveTargetsOf`, `FIELD_TYPES`.

## Where to change what

A new field type: one entry in `FIELD_TYPES` plus one copy label (`fieldTypes`). A new kind of text, number or date (the Text input, Number and Datetime picker groups): one variant entry in `FIELD_TYPE_GROUPS` (`FieldTypes.registry.ts`) plus one label under `fieldVariants`; a new palette item or group: `PALETTE_ORDER` there, with a label under `fieldGroups`. A type that may title a repeatable component's items: `canTitleItem` on its `FIELD_TYPES` entry (the item title and subtitle select lists come from `titleFieldCandidates`). A new key that only some types hold (like `unsigned`, `options`, `default`): one entry in `KEY_TYPE_RULES` of `SchemaTree.reducer.ts` plus the key in the order and shape lists of `SchemaJson.rules.ts`. A new tree action: one case in `SchemaTree.reducer.ts`. A new row control: `FieldRow.tsx` plus the handler in `SchemaCanvas.tsx`. Drag rules (offered lists, drop place, announcements): `SchemaDragContext.tsx` with its copy under `dnd`. A new field key control: `FieldPropertiesDialog.tsx` (a new list-valued control sits beside `EnumOptionsEditor` there). Export rules (when it is enabled, what it shows): `ExportPanel.tsx`. A new import refusal: `SchemaJson.rules.ts` plus its copy line under `import.refusal`. The task file list named `views-schema-builder.md`; this existing doc of the same folder was filled instead.
